meta.name: install-and-verify
meta.description: Verify that a web app change actually works by driving the running app from the inside (DOM, network, routing, console, framework state) instead of screenshots or guessing. Use after any user-facing change, when a fix is claimed but unproven, when a test passes but the UI is broken, or when you need a real verdict rather than "looks right". Also use to install and wire up Reticle in a project that does not have it yet.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 驱动正在运行的网页应用,把改动是否真的生效验个明白
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果改完前端却不敢确定页面是不是真的没坏
copy.tagline_en: Verify a web app change really works by driving the running app itself
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you changed a web UI and need proof it works, not a screenshot

howto.what: 它把 Reticle 的仅开发用 SDK 装进你正在跑的网页应用,然后从内部驱动这个页面(DOM、网络、路由、控制台、框架状态),跑完一段流程并给出结论:验证通过或未知,不再靠截图猜。项目里还没有 Reticle 时,它会先装好接好。
howto.when: 当你需要在改动后拿到真实结论——比如修复被声称但未证实、测试通过却界面坏了——或者项目还没装 Reticle 时触发。

say.text: 帮我验证一下这次改动到底生效没有。
say.note: 它会驱动运行中的应用,给出已验证或未知的结论。

say.text: 在这个项目里装上 Reticle 并接好。
say.note: 它会跑 init、起开发服务器、打开应用直到连上会话。

say.text: 重放 login 这条流程,看它还好不好用。
say.note: 它重放已保存的流程并给出结论。

howto.what_en: It installs Reticle's dev-only SDK into your running web app and drives that page from inside (DOM, network, routing, console, framework state) to give a verdict: verified or unknown. It also installs Reticle where the project lacks it.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need a real verdict after a change — a fix is claimed but unproven, or tests pass while the UI is broken — or when the project has no Reticle yet and needs installing.

say_en.text: Verify that this change actually works.
say_en.note: It drives the running app and returns verified or unknown.

say_en.text: Install and wire up Reticle in this project.
say_en.note: It runs init, starts the dev server and connects the app.

say_en.text: Replay the login flow and tell me if it still works.
say_en.note: It replays a saved flow and gives a verdict.
